content.title: School Closings | Delays | Early Release - Winchester Public Schools
content.text: School Closings and Delays Scheduled school closings are marked on our School Calendar. Schools may also close or open with a delay due to inclement weather or other unplanned events. Making the Call Careful consideration goes into deciding whether students can safely be transported to school on a snowy morning. Roads and sidewalks are inspected, and weather forecasts and outdoor temperatures are monitored. Information is then reported to the Superintendent, who makes a determination about whether to cancel classes for the day. The goal is to make a decision by 5:30 a.m. Notification If school is delayed or closed, a message will go out to all WPS staff and families. Info will also be posted on the WPS website and social media. Notify your school with any changes in contact information so you will receive weather-related messages. Winchester Public Schools on Facebook Winchester Public Schools on Instagram Distance Learning Plan When school is closed due to inclement weather, the day will likely be replaced with distance learning. Please read the information below and any messages from your student’s school. *Please note: If the opportunity for a true snow day without distance learning arises, you will be notified accordingly.
